gaps: A text hit does not establish a call or data-flow edge.
Dynamic configuration, reflection and unindexed libraries remain explicit gaps.
Requires configured Joern and a retained analysis; static paths do not prove runtime execution.

limits: References are navigation aids, not proof that a tool ran or every behavior is covered.
Actual transition/source coverage and browser/live reports are separate source-matched evidence.
Configured plugins and custom tools require their own integration tests.
